claims.text: Adaldrida was the daughter of Gundahar Bolger and Dina Diggle. She was the younger sister of Adalgar.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Bolger of Budgeford"

claims.text: Adaldrida married Marmadoc Brandybuck, and had four children: Gorbadoc, Orgulas and two daughters.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Brandybuck of Buckland"
